reason: 该插件的主要面向用户目的是提升 DSH Web 对话界面的浏览体验：在聊天滚动容器中平滑贴底动画、边缘回弹手感与可选逐字打字展示，并提供设置项进行控制。依据 README 与项目结构可见其为纯客户端 UI 行为增强插件，核心能力集中在界面布局/交互而非外部服务调用或数据处理。

summaries.zh: 该插件是 DSH Web 聊天界面的纯客户端交互增强插件，用于优化消息流动的滚动与显示体验，并提供可调的边缘回弹与逐字打字效果设置。
summaries.en: This plugin is a client-side enhancement for the DSH Web chat UI that improves scrolling and message reveal behavior with configurable edge bounce and typewriter-style typing effects.

capabilities: Injects a client-side script bundle into the DSH Web runtime
Observes and animates chat conversation scroll container behavior
Implements optional edge-bounce interaction for manual scrolling
Adds configurable message typewriter display behavior
Adds a settings UI entry set with persisted preferences

reasons.code: README describes the plugin as a DSH Web conversational UI effect plugin providing automatic follow scrolling, edge bounce, and stream-style typewriter behavior, plus a settings panel.
package.json exports a `./client` entry (`lib/client.js`) and declares DSH client runtime/ui slots injection targeting the web platform, indicating browser-side integration.
Repository tree lists `src/client/scroll-flow-controller.ts` and `src/client/typewriter.ts`, showing scroll control and typing effect logic in a dedicated client module.
